title: RAG pipeline — stage observability
description: Panel definitions for the ORQ-37 Gate A tracing seam. Tool-neutral on purpose: D-4 ships no hosted backend and no Compose service, so this artifact declares WHAT each panel reads, not which product renders it. Every span name, attribute key and span-intrinsic field below is checked against app/core/observability/schema.py by app/scripts/check_dashboard_schema.py (AC5).
notes: Panels read attributes only from the declared allow-list; the same artifact AC4 asserts emissions against.
Duration is a span-intrinsic field, never an attribute. `stage.duration_ms` was deliberately removed from the schema so no panel can reference a key nothing emits.

Panels marked "pending" reference spans that exist in the schema but are not emitted until a later gate. They are listed so the dashboard is designed once, and the checker reports them separately from valid panels.

panels.title: Requests — volume and latency
panels.pending_reason: The request span is minted by RequestContextMiddleware at T8; the schema declares it now so the panel is not redesigned later.

panels.title: Stage completeness — spans entered per request
panels.measurement_note: Counts spans ENTERED, not spans that succeeded. A rerank that fell back is reached and must appear here; see §Diseño 1 'Expected spans'.

panels.title: Retrieval — candidate yield and empty-corpus rate
Reranker — fallback rate and ranked count
panels.measurement_note: A fallback is a designed degradation, not a span error: it is counted via rag.fallback_used, never via span status.

panels.title: Evaluator — trigger rate and verdict split
Conversation memory — assembly and ranking
panels.pending_reason: memory.assemble arrives at Gate B1 and memory.rank at Gate B2. Out of scope for T4; declared so the panel is not invented twice.
